meta.title: Ferdynand Odhiambo - AI-Native Product Engineer
meta.description: AI-Native Product Engineer in Nairobi, Kenya, building cross-platform applications, backend platforms and tools for distributed systems.

hero.bio: I work across product and engineering: finding workflows where AI can create business value, then building the applications, services and platform capabilities to deliver it. I’m growing my open-source work around tools for testing distributed and network-dependent software.

paragraphs: I build across the product stack: turning business workflows into cross-platform applications, then supporting them with backend services, integrations and infrastructure designed to remain reliable as products grow. My experience includes Go and Python services for payment processing, event-driven workflows, data pipelines and microservices.

AI is one capability I apply where it can improve a workflow. I use validated outputs, deterministic controls and clear evaluation; my work includes financial document processing and stablecoin risk systems. My next open-source focus is developer tooling that helps teams test and operate distributed applications under slow, unreliable or unavailable network conditions.

contact.heading: Open to AI-native product, platform and developer tooling roles.
contact.body: Interested in building valuable applications and reliable systems for distributed software. Available for full-time, contract and freelance work, remote or based in Nairobi.
